IT IS EXPECTED THAT SUCH ADVANCES WILL BE ENABLING FOR APPLICATIONS INCLUDING SEARCH AND RESCUE, DISASTER RELIEF, HAZARDOUS ENVIRONMENT INSPECTION, IN-FLIGHT CONTROL OF AERODYNAMIC PLATFORMS, STEERABLE OPTICS, AND PROSTHETICS.
